Run one simulation

Source: R/run.R
run_sim.Rd

Launches SLiM with the given parameters and writes the run into outdir: events.tsv, state.tsv, plasmo.trees and params.tsv, with model.slim, cmdline.txt, run.log and DONE (see The run directory). params.tsv records every parameter, floats to the 15 significant digits passed to SLiM. The launch is shell-free (processx), so it handles the SLiM quoting pitfalls for you.

Usage

run_sim(
  params = vivax_params(),
  seed = 1L,
  outdir,
  model = slim_model(),
  verbose = NULL,
  timeout = Inf,
  echo = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  skip_existing = FALSE
)

Arguments

params

a vivax_params() object, or a named list of overrides. Either is checked by vivax_params() again before the run, so an object edited after it was built is checked too.

seed

integer RNG seed. SLiM starts from it (-s) and the model sets it as SEED, so the outputs and the tree-sequence provenance both record it.

outdir

the run's directory, created when the run has finished (its parent is created if needed). A directory that already holds a run is not replaced unless overwrite = TRUE, and a directory holding other files is never used; these refusals are errors of class malariafwd_outdir_in_use.

model

path to the SLiM model (defaults to the bundled template).

verbose

if TRUE, run the model in VERBOSE mode (full per-event narration). NULL (default) leaves the param as set (quiet).

timeout

seconds before the run is stopped, with an error saying so (Inf = no limit).

echo

if TRUE, stream SLiM output live to the console.

overwrite

if TRUE, a run already in outdir is replaced, once the new run has finished. Only run files are ever deleted.

skip_existing

if TRUE and outdir already holds this run (the same parameters, seed and model), it is returned without running SLiM.

Value

invisibly, a vivax_run object: the run directory, its parameter set, seed, outcome, versions, genome and complete (see load_run()). A run that goes extinct, with no parasite left and no importation still to come, ends on that tick and gives a message; so does a founder-free run whose imports never established a parasite.

The run directory

The run is written into a new directory beside outdir and moved to outdir only when it has finished, so outdir holds a whole run or what it held before, never a mix. DONE, written last, records when the run finished, how long it took, its seed, a key of its parameters and seed, the md5 of the model, the versions, and the size of every file; load_run() reports a directory whose DONE is missing or whose files have changed since. SLiM runs in the run's directory (OUTDIR is '.') on the copy of the model it holds, model.slim, so the directory is self-contained: cmdline.txt gives the arguments, and running slim with them in a directory holding model.slim repeats the run. A custom model that reads other files must use absolute paths. A run that fails, times out or is interrupted leaves its files and run.log in <outdir>.failed; if R itself is killed, a <outdir>.partial-* directory is left beside outdir, to delete by hand.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # slim_available()
run <- run_sim(vivax_params(SIM_DAYS = 100), seed = 1, outdir = tempfile("demo"))
run
summarise_run(run)
}
